A bar is not the same thing as a measurement. Lesson 71 measured a correlation of 0.9464 and lesson 76 counted thirteen orders in twenty-nine days; those are inputs, and a book cannot pass or fail them. A bar is a number with a side: clear it and you may proceed, miss it and you may not. Eleven lessons state one. Six others hand the book something it needs in order to be judged at all.
